entries.ro: Sânge peste tot. Treabă de începător.

entries.en: Came here alone, no backup... Probably a deal gone wrong.
entries.en_m: Came here alone, no backup... It's probably a deal gone wrong.
entries.ro: Am venit singură, fără backup... Probabil o afacere care a mers prost.

entries.en: Let's see what we got here...
Muscles aren't stiff yet... Dead couple hours, tops.
